gpu: Radeon Pro V620 (gfx1030), HIP 4 on par1-cs25 (PCI bus 0xdf, 175 W package cap); tuned once, the new rows are written identically to rank files 0-3
storage_policy: Opt-in derived profile (auto: false in tunableop/profiles.json): the canonical rocm7.14-rocblas5.5 rank files 0-3 byte-for-byte plus the rows below, so that no other recipe's lookup table changes. Selected by TUNABLEOP_PREFER=rocm7.14-rocblas5.5-hi2-27b-tp2 in tools/rdna/recipes/27b-hi2-tp2.env only; TUNABLEOP_PREFER= (empty) loads the canonical rows. Same rocBLAS build and lib_sha256 as the canonical profile. Never store rows in /tmp or the run CWD.
rank_policy: Ranks 0-3 hold the canonical rows plus identical new rows (TP=2 workers read ranks 0 and 1; one tuning on one V620 serves both ranks, same arch and build).

campaign.tools: tools/rdna/rdna_hint_flex/tunableop_hi2.sh (phases shapes, record, tune, gather, measure, check, curate, time, hit, emul), tunable_hi2.py, sched_census.py, tunable_report.py, tp2_emul_check.py
campaign.gpu_state: HIP 4 at 79-81 C junction, 175 W package cap, sclk 1300-1750 MHz during the measurement passes (2 s rocm-smi sampler of the alternating passes)
campaign.tuning: tune_missing_gemms.sh tune: PYTORCH_TUNABLEOP_ENABLED=1 TUNING=1 HIPBLASLT_ENABLED=0 TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_HIPBLASLT=0, TunableOp defaults (max 30 ms and 100 iterations per candidate), numerical check atol=rtol=2e-3, groups of 25 keys in 5 shards, one flock hold per shard

groups.prefill: 7 slots x M 1024, 2048 = 14 keys (10 adopted at the first measurement)
groups.sched2: 5 slots x M 1033, 1036, 1039, 1042, 1045 = 25 keys (MTP=2 mixed steps)

campaign.curation: cold-weight CUDA-graph timing, adopt >= 3 % faster than the heuristic; stage one on the median of the first pass and three alternating heuristic/tuned passes (34 borderline keys), stage two (sched2) on one pass
campaign.numerics: rowcheck.py on 89 candidate rows (gaussian and outlier-channel inputs, eager and HIP graph, vs fp64): 0 rejected, worst error ratio 1.00, tuned bits equal the default's for 32 and differ for 57
campaign.lookup: tunehit.py: 31 of 31 stage-one rows found with PYTORCH_TUNABLEOP_FILENAME at this folder (rows=3361 at that time)
campaign.model_level: tp2_emul_check.py, 3 prompts x 64 greedy tokens: tokens identical, max |dlogit| 0.094 (top-20 raw fp16 logits); doc section 4.2
campaign.open_gate: deterministic concurrency probe on HIP 2,3 (flat all-reduce) not run
